steps.en: Officer selects notices and starts Batch Furnish
steps.id: Officer memilih notice dan memulai Batch Furnish

steps.en: Non-furnishable notices are flagged before the update
steps.id: Notice yang tidak furnishable ditandai sebelum update
steps.why_en: The warning count includes notices that will fail, and none are filtered out.
steps.why_id: Jumlah di peringatan ikut menghitung notice yang akan gagal, dan tidak ada yang disaring.

steps.en: Officer picks owner, hirer or driver
steps.id: Officer memilih owner, hirer atau driver

steps.en: Form shows the offender fields to fill in
steps.id: Form menampilkan field offender yang harus diisi

steps.en: Officer confirms before the update runs
Same particulars are applied to all selected notices
steps.id: Data yang sama diterapkan ke semua notice terpilih

steps.en: Officer sees a success prompt with the notice count
steps.id: Officer melihat prompt sukses dengan jumlah notice

steps.en: Notice moves to the next stage for automated follow-up
steps.id: Notice pindah ke stage berikutnya untuk tindak lanjut otomatis
steps.why_en: The stage is set, but the follow-up rules cannot be checked here and letters only run manually.
steps.why_id: Stage diubah, tetapi aturan tindak lanjut tidak bisa dicek di sini dan surat hanya jalan manual.
